name: voracious_greatshark_counters_an_artifact_spell
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'Flash. When this creature enters, counter target artifact or creature spell.' On seat 1's turn seat 1 casts Goldvein Pick (a noncreature artifact spell) and holds priority; in response seat 0 flashes in Voracious Greatshark, whose trigger counters it: the Pick goes to seat 1's graveyard.
